title: Consent Banner Plus
summary: A generic analytics dashboard with a configurable cookie banner.
intended_users: Small website operators who want a banner before loading analytics.

design_decisions.problem_or_constraint: The site needs a visible consent choice before analytics initialization.
design_decisions.alternatives_considered: No alternatives were documented beyond using the existing vendor SDK.
design_decisions.chosen_approach_and_rationale: Gate vendor initialization on a local boolean.
design_decisions.accepted_trade_off: The implementation does not provide granular purposes, revocation UI, or server-side enforcement.
design_decisions.validation_approach: Manual browser clicking only; no automated evidence is included.
design_decisions.reconsideration_conditions: Reconsider if the analytics vendor changes its API.

testing_strategy: The team manually clicked accept once. There are no automated tests or negative-path records.
security_threat: Analytics collection could occur without meaningful consent. The client delays one SDK initialization call until acceptance. Residual risk: No inventory of other trackers, retention limits, data minimization, withdrawal flow, or consent integrity controls exists.
production_limitation: Consent state is browser-local and other scripts can bypass the component.
technical_debt: Add revocation, purpose-specific controls, server enforcement, and a tracker inventory.
track_alignment_explanation: The submission claims Privacy by Design because it has a banner, but privacy is incidental to a general analytics dashboard and the repository contains no broader privacy architecture.
